flags.why: This is a formal word used for official inspection visits, so leaving it untagged misrepresents its register ([dictionary](https://dictionary.zim.vn/viet-anh/thi-sat-tieng-anh-la-gi)).
The threatening sense remains in everyday spoken use and is not rare ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/ham-ehcCAH0O5DJn7.html)).
The woven bamboo sheet sense is also routinely used in Southern Vietnamese, so Northern is misleading ([Southern supplier usage](https://thicongnhala.com/cot-ep-tre)).
